originalTitle: Bali gym owner kicks out three Israeli tourists for links to ‘IDF’
title: A Story About Sharing and Being Kind, Far Away in Bali!
content:
Hello, Super Friends!

Hi everyone! I'm your friendly news reporter, bringing you stories from all over the world, especially for kids like you right here in amazing Africa! We love to learn new things, don't we? Today, we have a story from a faraway place called Indonesia. It's a country made up of many, many islands, where the sun shines bright and the beaches are beautiful. One of its most famous islands is called Bali. It's like a big, sunny playground where lots of people go for holidays!

What Happened in Bali?

So, imagine you're on holiday, and you want to go somewhere fun. Maybe a place to run, jump, and play, like a big indoor playground for grown-ups. This place is called a gym. It's where people go to exercise and make their bodies strong. In Bali, there's a gym, and the person who owns it, the gym owner, had some visitors. Three people, who were visiting Bali, wanted to use the gym. We call people who visit other countries 'tourists'. They come to see new places, eat new foods, and have adventures. These three tourists were from a country called Israel. But when they came to the gym, the owner said, 'No, you cannot come in.'

Why Did the Owner Say No?

This might sound a bit strange, right? Usually, when you visit a place, people are happy to welcome you. But this gym owner said 'no' to these specific visitors. He even made a video about it and put it on the internet for everyone to see. The internet is like a giant message board where people share pictures and videos with friends and family, and sometimes with the whole world! In his video, the owner explained why he didn't want the tourists from Israel in his gym. He said he was worried because of some big, grown-up disagreements happening very, very far away. He felt that because these people were from that country, he didn't want them in his gym. It’s like sometimes, grown-ups have big, important discussions that can make them feel worried or upset, and sometimes these feelings can make them act in ways that are not always fair to everyone. Did you know? Indonesia is a country with thousands of islands! It's super huge! And Bali is just one beautiful spot where many people from all over the world love to visit.

What Are Tourists?

Let's talk a little more about tourists. A tourist is someone who travels from their home country to another country just to have fun, see new things, and relax. They might visit big cities, explore nature, or just enjoy the sunshine on a beach, like in Bali! Imagine your auntie or uncle going to a new village to see a special festival. They are tourists in that village! They are visitors, and we usually like to make visitors feel happy and welcome, don't we? We offer them food, show them around, and make sure they have a good time. That's how we often are in Africa – friendly and welcoming to everyone who visits.

What is a Gym?

And what about a gym? A gym is a place where people go to do exercises. You might see big machines for running, lifting weights, or doing stretches. It helps people keep their bodies strong and healthy. Kids usually have playgrounds to run and jump, but grown-ups often go to a gym. It's a place for everyone to get fit, no matter where they are from. Did you know? Exercise is super important for kids too! Running, playing football, jumping rope – all these things help you grow big and strong, just like going to a gym helps grown-ups!

Thinking About Fairness and Kindness

This story makes us think about treating everyone fairly. In many places, when someone visits from another country, they are usually welcomed with open arms. We often say, 'A visitor is a blessing!' We don't usually ask where they come from or what their country's grown-up problems are before we offer them a drink of water or a place to rest. It’s important to remember that people who travel, like these tourists, are just regular people trying to have a nice holiday. They might not be involved in the big, grown-up disagreements that happen in their home country. It can feel sad when someone is not welcomed just because of where they are from, or because of things their country’s grown-ups are doing far away that have nothing to do with them. Here in Africa, we know a lot about welcoming people. People from all over the world come to see our beautiful animals, our amazing cultures, and our friendly smiles. We believe in ubuntu, which means 'I am because we are.' It’s about being kind and understanding that we are all connected.

Our African Message

This story from Bali teaches us that sometimes, even far away, people can make choices that might not seem fair to everyone. But for us, it's a chance to remember how important it is to be kind, to be welcoming, and to treat everyone with respect, no matter where they come from. Imagine if you went to a new place and someone said you couldn't play just because your neighbour did something they didn't like! That wouldn't feel very good, would it? So, let’s remember to always be friendly, to share our smiles, and to make everyone feel welcome, whether they are from down the road or from a country far, far away across the big oceans. Because at the end of the day, we are all people, and kindness is a language everyone understands! Did you know? Africa is a huge continent with 54 different countries! That means there are many, many different languages, cultures, and friendly people waiting to welcome you! Keep shining bright, young friends!
summary: In Bali, Indonesia, a gym owner refused service to three Israeli tourists, explaining in an online video that he was worried due to big grown-up disagreements happening far away in their home country.
whyMatters: This story is important because it shows us that sometimes people are not welcomed just because of where they come from, making us think about how we can always be kind and fair to everyone, no matter their origin.
